title: Parse, add calendar months and days, format
summary: Parse an ISO 8601 date-time, add calendar months (clamping to month end) and days, and format it back.
notes: The JavaScript entries (date-fns, dayjs) parse into a Date and do the arithmetic in the process's local time zone; the Rust entries (chrono, jiff) use civil date-times with no zone. The fixtures are chosen so both give the same answer. Every entry returns a newly formatted string in the one required format, compared exactly.
